group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Project identity and address. Prompt to staff only if missing: Are we working on the correct client and site? Show current Sales value.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Drawings. Which plan set, sheet list, issue date and revision are we reviewing? Link existing document record; no reupload if present.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Concept Meeting/Presentation record and key decisions already made. Surface existing meeting facts; never force re-entry.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Client budget target, timing expectations and design priorities. Show current dated Sales fact; ask only to confirm material changes.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: What do you most want to improve: space, natural light, comfort, privacy, entertaining, storage, accessibility, low maintenance, energy use? Pick up to 3 priorities plus note.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: What parts of the property are in this project, what are possible extras, and what is explicitly future work? Tag areas as Included / Optional / Excluded / Deferred.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Physical project type: New Build / Renovation / Extension / Combined. Delivery model separately Design & Build / Build Only / Management / Other; never combine types in one ambiguous field.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Will the property remain occupied or operational through work? Record temporary facility and access requirements only when relevant.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Which decisions must be made before the next architect issue, budget check or PTSA? Owner, not necessarily due date.

group: ENTRY: PROJECT CONTEXT (MOSTLY PREFILLED FROM SALES)
text: Existing architects/consultants/suppliers and known agreements; link from Hub, not new text if authoritative contact already exists.
Site access: restricted driveway, narrow site, crane/delivery access, neighbour restrictions, steep slope or parking? Note known facts, inspection tasks.
Survey, boundaries, easements, services, geotech and site levels: which reports exist and which are required? Internal consultant action, not client specification.
Trees, retaining walls, external structures and landscaping affected by construction? Include/retain/protect/remove/by others.
What is being demolished, retained, altered and made good in the existing building? Record by area, not one vague demolition line.
Existing structural, moisture, termite, asbestos/contamination, roof and foundation conditions: inspected / assumed / needs test; source.
What existing finishes and fixtures must be protected and/or matched? Note acceptable variation or inability to match exact old products.
Will the family live on site? Work zones, temporary kitchen/bathroom, dust separation, service outages and safe access.
Where do new and existing work connect: roof, wall, floor, drainage, electrical, thermal envelope? Add interface action and drawing ref.
Overall project quality priorities: standard / upgraded / individually specified, and where is investment most important? Do not fabricate a universal inclusions package.
External works scope: driveway, landscaping, paths, fencing, retaining, pergola, pool or boundary work included/excluded/deferred?
Unknown conditions likely to affect cost and design. Is investigation, contingency, exclusion or alternate scope appropriate?
Planning/building approval and consultant design responsibilities. Identify who verifies requirements, not legal assertions based on questionnaire.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Overall architectural material direction: masonry, render, lightweight cladding, timber feature, metal roof? What should the home look and feel like?

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Roof and gutter colour/material preference; roof profile/pitch/box gutter details to architect later.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Windows and glazing priorities: frame appearance, opening use, sun/shading, privacy, thermal/acoustic performance, insect screens.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Envelope quality: comfort/energy efficiency, insulation, airtightness and moisture management priority. Technical compliance by designers.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: General interior floor palette by zone: timber/laminate/hybrid/tile/carpet/polished concrete, wet-area separate.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Internal doors and trims: standard or feature doors, general door heights, skirting/architraves/cornice and hardware style.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: General paint and ceiling finish direction: warm/cool palette, matte/sheen, square set/cornice, feature areas.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Heating/cooling, ventilation and hot water preference; any required comfort zones or special rooms?

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Electrical, smart home, data, solar/battery/EV charging ambitions; note special requirements, not layouts yet.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Window furnishings, appliances, loose furniture, fireplaces, landscaping, security and automation: included, by client, excluded or future?

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Standard supply/installation responsibilities for selected products and any client-supplied items; warranty and lead time implications noted internally.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Document current building performance goal and required consultant checks (energy, thermal, fire, acoustic, moisture, accessibility as applicable). No automatic certification label.

group: WHOLE-HOUSE GENERAL INCLUSIONS AND MATERIAL STANDARDS
text: Identify outstanding whole-house decision that materially changes cost/design and allocate owner.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Room/zone name, level, drawing sheet/revision, order on plans; type: kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, hall, external etc.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: For THIS room: New / Renovate / Alter / Retain Existing / Remove / Make Good / By Others / Excluded / Deferred / N/A.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: What is being done here? One clear sentence, then inclusions/exclusions, retaining elements and existing condition notes.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: What's most important about how this room works? Storage, circulation, accessibility, light/privacy, entertaining or durability.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Floor finish: inherit whole-house default or select room exception; check steps/transitions if relevant.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Wall, ceiling and feature finish: use defaults or note different materials/ceiling height/cornices.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Internal/external doors, windows, screens or opening alterations specific to this room.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Lighting, power, data, comfort/ventilation needs as a broad prompt. Count/position in detailed electrical coordination.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Joinery, fixtures, appliances, equipment or loose furniture: included, owner supplied or by others?

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: What's undecided, what changes the scope, and who follows up? Record only meaningful actions.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Reference relevant drawing/consultant/supplier document and version; don't type from memory when source exists.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Detail development and price/documentation status: design verified? trade quote/allowance? who is coordinating?

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Existing-to-new floor/wall/ceiling/service junction and matching/make-good requirements.

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Any scope item supplied or installed by the client, other trade or external consultant?

group: SHARED ROOM CARD (APPLIES TO EVERY ROOM OR AREA)
text: Tolerances and installation constraints that drive joinery/fixture/structural coordination (not client engineering choices).
New kitchen vs replace fronts vs partial retrofit? Existing kitchen demolition and make-good extent.
Layout: island, peninsula, scullery, pantry, circulation and family use priorities. Link joinery drawings.
Storage: full-height, walk-in, drawers, appliance garage, bins, pantry shelving, integrated appliances.
Cabinetry standard/look: flat-panel, profile, timber veneer/laminate/paint, cabinet interior standard.
Benchtop: preferred surface, appearance, thickness style; final product/edge/joints after PTSA.
Splashback: tile, stone, glass or other; preferred extent/colour; detailed layout later.
Sink and mixer: bowl arrangement, undermount/topmount, finish, water filter/hot tap; Routleys source later.
Appliances: list cooktop, oven, rangehood, dishwasher, fridge, microwave, wine storage; who supplies/install and any specialty dimensions?
Cooking/exhaust requirements, induction/gas preference, outdoor connection and ventilation considerations.
Power, feature lighting, LED strips and data/charging; location layout by electrician later.
Joinery hardware/drawers, handles/push-to-open, panels, plinths, clearances, stone shop drawings, service setouts and quantities.
Main budget drivers or unresolved choices: kitchen footprint, stone choice, appliance tier, specialty hardware, scullery scope.
Appliance procurement, supplier selections, long-lead items, installation and warranty responsibility.
Coordinate supplier product dimensions with cabinetry, electrical, plumbing and drawings; verify, don't auto-approve.
Existing bathroom retained, full renovation or new? Demolition, protection, access and make-good.
Room layout and priorities: shower-only, bath, double vanity, separate WC, storage, accessibility.
Toilet: back-to-wall, wall-hung, concealed cistern, existing retained; brand/model later.
Vanity: wall-hung/floorstanding, size, top material, basin number/type, drawers/storage.
Basin: inset/above-counter/undermount, shape/finish and likely plumbing constraint.
Shower: walk-in or enclosed, overhead/hand shower, screen style, niche, seat, hobless preference.
Bath: built-in/freestanding/none, location and quality; specific size/model later.
Tapware/accessories: finish direction, mixer types, towel rails, hooks, toilet-roll holders and mirrors.
Wall and floor finishes: tile type, size, full/partial tile heights, feature tile, grout colour and trim approach.
Heating and ventilation: exhaust fan, window, underfloor heating, heated towel rail.
Mirror/shaving cabinet, lighting, power outlets and electrical zones.
Waterproofing scope, drainage/waste, falls, thresholds, shower recess/screen/niche setouts for designer/trade verification.
Confirm product rough-in dimensions and approvals against Routleys selection pack and plumbing drawings.
Client-supplied fixtures vs Blue Leaf procurement and installation; any appliance or specialist installer.
Significant decisions unresolved before wet-area setout, tender and ordering.
New or retained laundry, demolition, appliance relocation, cupboard and floor/wall making-good.
Washing machine/dryer layout: stacked/side-by-side; underbench; ventilation.
Cabinetry, bench, trough, mixer, splashback, storage/broom cupboard and drying rail.
Flooring, skirting, tiled splash protection and door/wet-zone finish.
Waste, taps, hot-water provision, external access, power/GPO and appliance clearances.
Appliance supply responsibilities and any built-in whitegoods; client-owned equipment.
Product size unknowns, existing drainage and retained service constraints.
New/altered/retained space; walls/openings to remove, flooring and ceiling transitions.
Seating/dining layout, indoor-outdoor connection, TV/wall position, storage and acoustics.
Floor finish, threshold details, feature wall, ceiling finish/height, cornice/trim exception.
Window/slider/stacker style, glazing/shading, flyscreens, privacy and window-covering scope.
Fireplace/gas/electric appliance, built-in cabinetry, TV wall, shelving; included/by client?
Lighting modes, power/data/AV, fans, heating/cooling and daylight control.
Structural openings, beams, lintels, access and glazing coordination to architect/engineer.
Confirm furniture/layout-driven electrical and procurement decisions.
New, existing retained or refurbished; any partitions or built-in removals?
Bed/desk placement, access, future furniture, storage and privacy.
Floor finish, general paint, feature wall, trim, doors and hardware.
Wardrobe layout: robe doors, shelves, drawers, hanging and lighting; standard or custom.
Windows/glazing/screens, blackout/window furnishings, acoustic privacy.
Ceiling fan, reverse-cycle zone, GPO/data and lighting needs.
Outstanding robe layout/fitting and electrical decisions.
Stair type/location, change to existing stair, new stair or no stair; engineering/design responsibility.
Stair treads/risers, balustrade/handrail material, finish and lighting intent.
Hall/entry flooring transitions, feature cladding, joinery, door and hardware.
Front entry door: material, glazing, pivot/hinged, hardware, security and thresholds.
Entry storage, coats/shoes and visitor movement/lighting.
Garage: size, door motor/finish, storage, access door, slab/finish, insulation and services.
EV charger, workshop power, hot/cold water, garage floor coating, security and ventilation.
Stair geometry/balustrade compliance, structural and fire/acoustic design to responsible consultant.
Is alfresco/deck/verandah/pergola/balcony included, future, by client or excluded? Areas and levels.
Covered vs open, all-season use, BBQ/outdoor kitchen, privacy, orientation and shade.
External flooring: concrete/pavers/deck/tiles, levels, steps, drainage and slip resistance requirement.
Roof, soffit, posts, screens, ceiling fan/heater and cladding finish direction.
Outdoor lighting, power, gas/water/drain connections, sink/fridge/BBQ provisions.
Driveway, paths, fences, gates, boundary wall, retaining, landscaping, turf and irrigation included?
Pool, outdoor shower, sauna, fire pit, shed or future additions by others?
Balustrades, waterproofed balconies, drainage, structural spans, roof connections and consents to engineer/designer.
Boundary, drainage, existing-to-new and staging/contract exclusion issues.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm survey, geotechnical assumptions, setout, cut/fill, retaining, spoil, truck/access, stormwater, contaminated material/trees; owner, document reference.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm footing/slab design, reinforcement, waterproofing, termite management, subfloor ventilation and ground levels; engineer/certifier responsibilities.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm framing material, roof/floor systems, engineered beams, steel, bracing, tie-down and temporary support; designer approval and issue revision.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm brick/masonry/blocks, cladding substrate, fixing details, movement joints, cavity/ventilation, weep holes, lintel/flashings.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm pitch, sheet/tile type, roof drainage, penetrations, eaves, gutters/box gutters, downpipes, sarking/membrane and condensation strategy.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm window ID, opening sizes, handing, frame/material/finish, energy/glass, safety/acoustic/BAL where applicable, screens, reveals, water management, schedule revisions.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm internal/external door schedule, heights, widths, leaf type, jamb, seal, fire/acoustic where applicable, hardware/locksets, handles, garage motors.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm insulation continuity, vapour/water-control layers, thermal bridges, airtightness, ventilation and window/roof/slab junction detailing, performance evidence.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm plasterboard/cement sheet, ceiling profiles, feature substrate, wet-area lining, cornice/setout, acoustic requirements.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm wet-area substrate/falls, membrane, hobs, wastes, wet-area joinery junctions and balcony/external waterproofing system.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm substrate preparation, moisture, level transitions, tile/stone/timber/hybrid/carpet product, underlay and installation requirements.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm paint system, substrate, number of coats/colour/sheens and feature/timber/metal finishes.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm cabinet/shop drawings, panel/hinge/runner types, laminates, stone, tolerances, fixtures, service cutouts and approvals.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm hot/cold water, roof/stormwater, sanitary/drainage, fixture rough-ins, hot water system and specialist supplier schedule revisions.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm general power, RCD/switchboard, lighting legend, switches, data/AV, solar/EV/smart/security and exact fixture positions.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm mechanical sizing, zones, duct/penetration routes, bathrooms/kitchen exhaust, makeup air and controls.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm relevant NCC version, design energy assessment, approvals, special site conditions, thermal/glazing/fire/BAL ratings where applicable (all require qualified review, no guessed compliance).

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm decking/substructure, external paving/slopes, balconies, decks/pergolas, retaining/fences, drainage and landscaping interfaces.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm strip-out extents, isolation/protection, temporary works, waste and disposal, latent hazard investigation, service alterations.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm roof/floor/wall/slab interface, levels, material matching or transition, damp/air/thermal continuity, structural differential movement and remedial making-good.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Identify long lead materials, owner supply versus Blue Leaf/trade supply and install, procurement schedule and warranty liabilities.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Confirm scope item priced/allowed/excluded against current drawings; source quote/date, quantity confidence, GST and contract-specific allowance classification.

group: ELEMENT-BASED TECHNICAL / WORK PACKAGE PROMPTS (NOT ROUTINELY CLIENT QUESTIONS)
text: Reconcile specification, supplier schedule, drawings and approved register versions to prevent cross-version tender errors.
Who owns design coordination: client architect, Blue Leaf, other? Design deliverables and communication route.
Who engages and pays each consultant, surveyor, certifier and authority? Record contract responsibility, not just contact.
Who sources, orders, stores and warrants each fixture/finish/major component? Who installs it? Avoid 'client supplied' ambiguity.
Which items are direct client costs, construction management fees, trade packages or excluded? Link commercial terms; do not invent pricing.
What approvals/decisions can Blue Leaf give versus those requiring client/designer signature?
Programme and interface responsibility between other trades and Blue Leaf; site access/occupation risks.
